description: INSIDER LEAK (a Financial District event the Games Master can draw, 3 hours): read what is happening. A sealed tip about a paper-Exchange stock goes to up to 3 traders only; this shows how many got one and the public seal hash, never the tip. It is a claim from a public seed, not a fact: it can be wrong. The reveal at the end shows the tip, the real price move and who traded it. Read only, no token.
name: insider_state
